text:
alex-customer: Hey team — after upgrading to redwood-python 1.8.0 our generate() calls started failing with a TypeError. Worked fine on 1.7.x. Minimal repro below.

sara-cs: Sorry you're hitting that — can you paste the traceback and the snippet you're calling?

alex-customer: sure, repro: 
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_API_KEY'])
resp = client.generate(model_name='redwood-1.0', prompt='Hello')
```
Trace: 
```
TypeError: generate() got an unexpected keyword argument 'model_name'
  File "app.py", line 23, in <module>
    resp = client.generate(model_name='redwood-1.0', prompt='Hello')
```

mike-sdk: quick context: 1.8.0 removed some legacy param aliases and standardized on `model` instead of `model_name`. We tightened function signatures to improve typing and routing. Changelog has it but understandable if missed.

alex-customer: ugh — was that a breaking change? We didn't see it flagged.

sara-cs: For now pin to the last 1.7 patch to restore behavior: `pip install 'redwood==1.7.3'`. That should unblock you immediately.

alex-customer: pinned to 1.7.3, confirmed tests green. Thanks.

dan-engineering: tagging eng — @mike-sdk can we add a short-term compatibility shim to accept `model_name` and emit a DeprecationWarning, then ship 1.8.1? Also update upgrade notes.

mike-sdk: plan: 1) add alias shim for `model_name` -> `model` in generate and other entrypoints, 2) log DeprecationWarning, 3) add unit tests, 4) cut 1.8.1. I'll open a PR.

jen-release: I'll prep a patch release checklist and can accelerate once CI is clean. Link the PR here when ready.

mike-sdk: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-python/pull/432 (branch: compat/model-name-alias). Includes shim + tests.

sara-cs: Alex — ETA for the patch is ~1-2 business days; for large customers we can send a short KB recommending pinning over the weekend.

alex-customer: thanks. One more: any other param renames we should watch for (we pass `max_len`, `temperature` etc)?

mike-sdk: short list from the draft changelog: `model_name` -> `model` (alias in 1.8.1), `max_len` -> `max_tokens` (deprecation cycle: still accepted in 1.8 with a warning), `top_p`/`temperature` unchanged. We tried to keep changes minimal.

dan-engineering: note: tightened signatures can break wrappers that forward kwargs by inspecting signatures. If you do signature introspection, either pin to 1.7.x or update wrappers to accept `**kwargs`.

alex-customer: pinning for now, will test 1.8.1 when released.

support-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1123 — Python SDK param alias regression. Linked GH-432.

jen-release: 1.8.1 release created and scheduled after CI ✅ — ETA ~6 hours. Will post release notes and a short migration snippet when live.

alex-customer: installed 1.8.1 patch, tests pass. Appreciate the quick follow-up :thumbsup:

mike-sdk: thanks for the repro and patience — apologies for the friction. We'll publish the migration guide and expand the breaking-changes callout in the changelog.
